candidates.statement: Payment service returns 503 on POST /v1/authorizations, causing order to fail and gateway checkout to return 502. Traces show payment 503 errors propagating through order to /v1/checkout across multiple correlation IDs.
candidates.uncertainty: Payment-side logs/metrics not admitted; root cause of payment 503 (config, saturation, dependency) unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Gateway checkout 502s trace to order failing on payment 503 responses; inventory/redis path succeeds. Payment-side evidence is absent, so the bounded candidate is the 503 propagation, not payment's internal root cause.
missing_evidence: Payment service logs and metrics for /v1/authorizations 503s
Payment dependency health (postgresql) and resource saturation metrics
